children: Kandari brings more than two decades of luxury hospitality experience to the leadership role
The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts has appointed Pradeep Kandari as General Manager of The Leela Gandhinagar and the Mahatma Mandir Exhibition and Convention Centre (MMCEC).

Kandari brings more than two decades of experience in the hospitality sector to the role. His mandate will include enhancing guest experiences, driving business growth and strengthening the property's position within Gujarat's luxury hospitality market.

Kandari has been with The Leela since January 2023, during which he has held leadership roles across the brand's Bengaluru portfolio. Before his latest appointment, he served as Hotel Manager at The Leela Palace Bengaluru.

Prior to joining The Leela, Kandari held leadership positions with hospitality brands including The St. Regis Mumbai, Starwood Hotels & Resorts, Le Royal Méridien and Taj Hotels Resorts and Palaces. His international experience also includes an assignment with Manchester Marriott.

In his new role, Kandari will focus on operational excellence and personalised service while responding to the evolving expectations of luxury travellers. His responsibilities will also span the property's positioning across the convention, meetings, incentives, conferences and exhibitions (MICE), wedding and leisure segments.

Commenting on his appointment, Kandari said Gujarat is witnessing growth across luxury hospitality, convention, MICE, wedding and leisure travel. He added that the combination of The Leela Gandhinagar and MMCEC provides an opportunity to create experiences for both individual travellers and large-scale events while maintaining the brand's approach to Indian hospitality.

The appointment comes as The Leela Gandhinagar continues to develop its proposition as a luxury hospitality and events destination in Gujarat, with the hotel and convention centre serving both leisure and large-scale business and social events.
